title: Hateful Meme Detection through Context-Sensitive Prompting and Fine-Grained Labeling

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to detect homophobic and transphobic content by applying fine-grained categorical prompting on a dataset of multimodal hateful memes.
Evaluating the model's ability to detect misogynistic and sexist content by applying fine-grained categorical prompting on a dataset of multimodal hateful memes.
Evaluating the model's ability to detect politically motivated hate speech targeting individuals based on beliefs or affiliations using fine-grained categorical prompting.
Evaluating the model's ability to detect racism, xenophobia, anti-Black racism, and white supremacist rhetoric using fine-grained categorical prompting on multimodal hateful memes.
Evaluating the model's ability to detect bigotry, including anti-Muslim, Islamophobic, and anti-Semitic hate, using fine-grained categorical definitions in prompts.
Evaluating the model's ability to detect derogatory language and stereotypes mocking physical or mental disabilities using fine-grained categorical prompting.
